dedupe_keys.name: data set for publication a new industry oriented technique for the wideband characterization of voltage transformers

description: Gabriella Crotti and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The workbook supports the industry-oriented wideband-characterisation technique in Measurement 182:109674. Coverage is the data underlying Figures 3, 4, 6 and 7, with the file descriptor identifying the low-voltage SINDICOMP study. The source establishes experimental support for instrument-transformer response modelling; it does not expose the entire measurement campaign in its abstract. Exact test frequencies, transformer specifications and uncertainty propagation remain unknown. The companion method publications retain their separate analytical-model role. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
